morning.caption:
The Nasdaq fell 5.28% on Friday and turned negative for 2026 as Nvidia dropped 14.01% after a Reuters report that SEC staff are reviewing its accounting. The S&P 500 lost 3.70%, closed in correction and fell 8.6% for the week. Bitcoin slipped below $60,000.

Our read, labeled as judgment: selling in a panic locks in losses. General information, not investment advice. More at fiopoin.com

midday.caption:
The AAA national average fell to $3.69 on November 20, down from $4.27 a month earlier, and AAA says it could drop another 15 cents by Thanksgiving. Market odds from CME FedWatch put a 99.3% chance on a December rate hike, so card rates may rise. General information, not financial advice. More at fiopoin.com

evening.caption:
Iran's foreign minister said seven conditions must be met before Hormuz reopens, including lifting sanctions and the US blockade. Brent still settled at $92.57 on Friday, its third weekly loss. Our read, labeled as judgment: a 25% chance Brent tops $100 in 30 days. More at fiopoin.com
